name: Sant Martí de Llémena (Spain)
description: Dark green field charged with the purple Greek cross patée of the arms, over which lies a yellow sword in pale.
history: The flag was approved on 2 January 2013 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 6295 of 17 January 2013; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, dark green, with the purple Greek cross patée of the arms 2/3 of the height, placed equidistant from the upper and lower edges.

features.role: Greek cross patée of the arms, 2/3 of the height
sword in pale over the cross
